title: Her answer to a team question is recorded close to her words, and the reply just answers her
origin: Issue #169 (answers to founders' questions come back as alerts)

history.text: [voice: chapter 6 done, the desert scenes are so good]
Chapter 6 in the bag, Maya 📚 Same time tomorrow, chapter 7.
Morning Maya! Curious, what's made mornings the hardest part this week?

plan.reason: A chapter a night keeps the story moving without eating your evening.

step_days.proof_seen: voice recap of the desert scenes

team.body: Ask what's made mornings hardest for her this week

testerLines: honestly my alarm's across the room and I keep snoozing it
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH records her answer (the alarm across the room, snoozing) for the team, close to her words, and replies naturally to what she said (maybe a light idea), without mentioning the team and without asking the same question again.
